inputs.text: Edit image 1, changing ONLY her hair arrangement and removing the large purple bow. Preserve the original character identity, face, violet eyes, head size, chibi proportions, pose, black business suit, white shirt, pale lavender tie, black skirt, black shoes, clipboard, lavender horns and curled lavender tail EXACTLY. Her hair stays BRIGHT SNOW WHITE with pale LAVENDER shadows matching image 1, not gray, not silver-gray, no dark gray hair, no realistic shiny streaks. Keep her original fluffy bangs and the original cute rounded face. Gather her long hair naturally at the upper BACK of her head into ONE high ponytail with a tiny simple black elastic. The tie sits behind the crown, not on top of her forehead. The swept-back side hair connects smoothly to the ponytail root; no detached hairpiece, no top bun, no loop or protruding blob on top of the head. Two or three short fluffy face-framing locks remain, but no long loose hair on both sides. Her two lavender horns remain clearly separate from the ponytail. Match EXACTLY the original low-resolution pixel art: chunky square pixels, simple flat white and lavender color clusters, dark muted purple outlines, no gradients, no additional detail. Keep the same front facing full body idle pose and expression, white hair must remain the brightest white area, light gray plain background, no text. The high ponytail falls on the viewer left, slightly longer and fuller, with a single soft curl at its tip near hip height. Keep the hair outline balanced and tidy.
